sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.SKU AS sku,p.ProductName AS name,p.PimProductId AS productId,pp.price AS price,ad.addOnProductId AS addOnProductId,ad.addOnName AS addOnName,ch.child1Sku AS child1Sku,ch.child1Name AS child1Name,ch.child2Sku AS child2Sku,ch.child2Name AS child2Name,ch.child3Sku AS child3Sku,ch.child3Name AS child3Name,cat.categoryName AS categoryName,br.brandName AS brandName,pp.rp AS retailPrice,pp.sp AS salesPrice,ch.c1Id AS child1ProductId,ch.c2Id AS child2ProductId,ch.c3Id AS child3ProductId,sd.val AS shortDescription,ad.a1Pr AS addOnPrice,ad.a2Id AS addOn2ProductId,ad.a2Nm AS addOn2Name,ad.a2Pr AS addOn2Price,ad.a3Id AS addOn3ProductId,ad.a3Nm AS addOn3Name,ad.a3Pr AS addOn3Price,cpt.val AS categoryPath,tr.q1 AS tier1Qty, tr.tp1 AS tier1Price, tr.q2 AS tier2Qty, tr.tp2 AS tier2Price, tr.q3 AS tier3Qty, tr.tp3 AS tier3Price,tb.ld AS details, tb.sp AS specifications, tb.sh AS shippingInfo,inv1.v AS child1Inventory,inv2.v AS child2Inventory,inv3.v AS child3Inventory,ch.c1Q AS child1BundleQty,ch.c2Q AS child2BundleQty,ch.c3Q AS child3BundleQty,po.InStockMsg AS inStockMessage,agn.nm AS addOnGroupName,pz.cd AS personalizationCode FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId=p.PublishStateId JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode=@store CROSS APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice,pr.RetailPrice) AS price,pr.RetailPrice rp,pr.SalesPrice sp,pl.PriceListId plid FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId=pr.PriceListId JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plp ON plp.PriceListId=pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU=p.SKU AND plp.PortalId=po.PortalId AND pr.RetailPrice>@minPrice AND(pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate>=@now)AND(pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate>=@now)ORDER BY plp.Precedence,pl.PriceListId) pp OUTER APPLY(SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n1 THEN ax.id END) AS addOnProductId,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n1 THEN ax.nm END) AS addOnName,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n1 THEN ax.pr END) a1Pr,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n2 THEN ax.id END) a2Id,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n2 THEN ax.nm END) a2Nm,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n2 THEN ax.pr END) a2Pr,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n3 THEN ax.id END) a3Id,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n3 THEN ax.nm END) a3Nm,MAX(CASE WHEN ax.rn=@n3 THEN ax.pr END) a3Pr FROM(SELECT ao.PimProductId AS id,ao.ProductName nm,MAX(apx.price) pr,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder,apd.DisplayOrder,ao.PimProductId) rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId=ap.PimAddonGroupId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId=ap.PimAddOnProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId=apd.PimChildProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU=ao.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId=ai.WarehouseId CROSS APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 COALESCE(apr.SalesPrice,apr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePrice apr JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList apl ON apl.PriceListId=apr.PriceListId JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal aplp ON aplp.PriceListId=apl.PriceListId WHERE apr.SKU=ao.SKU AND aplp.PortalId=po.PortalId AND apr.RetailPrice>@minPrice AND(apl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apl.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(apl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apl.ExpirationDate>=@now)AND(apr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR apr.ActivationDate<=@now)AND(apr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR apr.ExpirationDate>=@now)ORDER BY aplp.Precedence,apl.PriceListId,apr.PriceId) apx WHERE ap.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive=@isActive AND apw.PortalId=po.PortalId AND(@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType=@addOnDisplayType)GROUP BY ao.PimProductId,ao.ProductName,ap.DisplayOrder,apd.DisplayOrder) ax) ad OUTER APPLY(SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child1Sku,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child1Name,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child2Sku,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child2Name,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.SKU END) AS child3Sku,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.ProductName END) AS child3Name,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.PimProductId END) c1Id,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.PimProductId END) c2Id,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.PimProductId END) c3Id,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n1 THEN kc.BundleQuantity END) c1Q,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n2 THEN kc.BundleQuantity END) c2Q,MAX(CASE WHEN kc.rn=@n3 THEN kc.BundleQuantity END) c3Q FROM(SELECT c.SKU,c.ProductName,c.PimProductId,a.BundleQuantity,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY a.DisplayOrder,c.PimProductId) rn FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId=a.PimProductId WHERE a.PimParentProductId=p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive=@isActive) kc) ch OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 ce.CategoryName AS categoryName FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ce JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity cv ON cv.VersionId=ce.VersionId JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog cc ON cc.PublishCatalogId=ce.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE ce.ZnodeProductId=p.PimProductId AND cc.PortalId=po.PortalId AND cv.RevisionType=@publishState AND cv.IsPublishSuccess=@publishSuccess AND ce.IsActive=@storefrontActive AND ce.IsObsolete=@storefrontObsolete AND ce.LocaleId=@localeId ORDER BY ce.VersionId DESC,ce.ProductIndex,ce.PublishProductEntityId) cat OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId=bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode=p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId=@localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId,bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY(SELECT TOP 1 sta.AttributeValue val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sav JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute spa ON spa.PimAttributeId=sav.PimAttributeId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue sta ON sta.PimAttributeValueId=sav.PimAttributeValueId AND sta.LocaleId=@localeId WHERE sav.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND spa.AttributeCode=@shortDescriptionCode ORDER BY sav.PimAttributeValueId) sd OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT_WS(@pathSep, g4.Name, g3.Name, g2.Name, g1.Name) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity ke INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity kv ON kv.VersionId = ke.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog kc ON kc.PublishCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g1 ON g1.VersionId = ke.VersionId AND g1.ZnodeCatalogId = ke.ZnodeCatalogId AND g1.LocaleId = ke.LocaleId AND g1.Name = ke.CategoryName AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, g1.ZnodeCategoryId, @comma), CONCAT(@comma, ke.ZnodeCategoryIds, @comma)) > @none LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h1 ON h1.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g1.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g2 ON g2.VersionId = g1.VersionId AND g2.LocaleId = g1.LocaleId AND g2.ZnodeCatalogId = g1.ZnodeCatalogId AND g2.ZnodeCategoryId = h1.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h2 ON h2.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g2.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g3 ON g3.VersionId = g2.VersionId AND g3.LocaleId = g2.LocaleId AND g3.ZnodeCatalogId = g2.ZnodeCatalogId AND g3.ZnodeCategoryId = h2.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy h3 ON h3.PimCategoryHierarchyId = g3.ZnodeCategoryId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity g4 ON g4.VersionId = g3.VersionId AND g4.LocaleId = g3.LocaleId AND g4.ZnodeCatalogId = g3.ZnodeCatalogId AND g4.ZnodeCategoryId = h3.ParentPimCategoryHierarchyId WHERE ke.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND kc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND kv.RevisionType = @publishState AND kv.IsPublishSuccess = @publishSuccess AND ke.IsActive = @storefrontActive AND ke.IsObsolete = @storefrontObsolete AND ke.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY ke.VersionId DESC, ke.ProductIndex, ke.PublishProductEntityId, g1.ZnodeCategoryId) cpt OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n1 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q1, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n1 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp1, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n2 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q2, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n2 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp2, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n3 THEN tq.Quantity END) AS q3, MAX(CASE WHEN tq.rn = @n3 THEN tq.Price END) AS tp3 FROM (SELECT t.Quantity, t.Price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.Quantity, t.PriceTierId) AS rn FROM dbo.ZnodePriceTier t WHERE t.PriceListId = pp.plid AND t.SKU = p.SKU) tq) tr OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @detailsCode THEN tx.v END) AS ld, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @specificationsCode THEN tx.v END) AS sp, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @shippingInfoCode THEN tx.v END) AS sh FROM (SELECT ta.AttributeCode AS c, COALESCE(tt.AttributeValue, tl.AttributeValue) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue tv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ta ON ta.PimAttributeId = tv.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue tt ON tt.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tt.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale tl ON tl.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE tv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ta.AttributeCode IN (@detailsCode, @specificationsCode, @shippingInfoCode)) tx) tb OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(wh.WarehouseName, @pairSep, CAST(iv.Quantity AS BIGINT)), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, aw.Precedence, aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory iv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeWarehouse wh ON wh.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse dw ON dw.PortalId = po.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalAlternateWarehouse aw ON aw.PortalWarehouseId = dw.PortalWarehouseId AND aw.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId WHERE iv.SKU = ch.child1Sku AND (iv.WarehouseId = dw.WarehouseId OR aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NOT NULL)) inv1 OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(wh.WarehouseName, @pairSep, CAST(iv.Quantity AS BIGINT)), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, aw.Precedence, aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory iv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeWarehouse wh ON wh.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse dw ON dw.PortalId = po.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalAlternateWarehouse aw ON aw.PortalWarehouseId = dw.PortalWarehouseId AND aw.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId WHERE iv.SKU = ch.child2Sku AND (iv.WarehouseId = dw.WarehouseId OR aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NOT NULL)) inv2 OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(wh.WarehouseName, @pairSep, CAST(iv.Quantity AS BIGINT)), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE WHEN aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, aw.Precedence, aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodeInventory iv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeWarehouse wh ON wh.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse dw ON dw.PortalId = po.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalAlternateWarehouse aw ON aw.PortalWarehouseId = dw.PortalWarehouseId AND aw.WarehouseId = iv.WarehouseId WHERE iv.SKU = ch.child3Sku AND (iv.WarehouseId = dw.WarehouseId OR aw.PortalAlternateWarehouseId IS NOT NULL)) inv3 OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 gl.AddonGroupName AS nm FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroup g ON g.PimAddonGroupId = ap.PimAddonGroupId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddonGroupLocale gl ON gl.PimAddonGroupId = g.PimAddonGroupId AND gl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE ap.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND (@addOnDisplayType IS NULL OR g.DisplayType = @addOnDisplayType) ORDER BY ap.DisplayOrder, ap.PimAddOnProductId) agn OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 zpa.AttributeCode AS cd FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue zav INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute zpa ON zpa.PimAttributeId = zav.PimAttributeId WHERE zav.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND zpa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable ORDER BY zpa.DisplayOrder, zpa.PimAttributeId) pz WHERE p.ProductType=@productType AND p.IsActive=@isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode=@publishState AND(@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU=@preferred)AND EXISTS(SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct c ON c.PimProductId=a.PimProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU=c.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId=i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId=p.PimProductId AND c.IsActive=@isActive AND pw.PortalId=po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity)>=@quantityUsed)AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT a.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a WHERE a.PimParentProductId=p.PimProductId AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT c.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct c JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU=c.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId=i.WarehouseId WHERE c.PimProductId=a.PimProductId AND c.IsActive=@isActive AND pw.PortalId=po.PortalId GROUP BY c.PimProductId HAVING SUM(i.Quantity)>=@quantityUsed))AND(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ap.PimAddOnProductId)FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct ap JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProductDetail apd ON apd.PimAddOnProductId=ap.PimAddOnProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct ao ON ao.PimProductId=apd.PimChildProductId JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory ai ON ai.SKU=ao.SKU JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.WarehouseId=ai.WarehouseId WHERE ap.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND ao.IsActive=@isActive AND apw.PortalId=po.PortalId)>=@minAddOns AND(@minAddOns=@none OR ad.addOnProductId IS NOT NULL)AND(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pa.PimAttributeId)FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId=av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable=@personalizable)>=@minPersonalizableAttributes AND(@personalizationAttribute IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT pa.PimAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId=av.PimAttributeId WHERE av.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND pa.IsPersonalizable=@personalizable AND pa.AttributeCode=@personalizationAttribute))AND EXISTS(SELECT pe.ZnodeProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId=pe.VersionId JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId=pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId=p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId=po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType=@publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess=@publishSuccess AND pe.IsActive=@storefrontActive AND pe.IsObsolete=@storefrontObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex>=@minProductIndex)AND(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rq.PimAddOnProductId)FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId=p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType=@requiredType)<=@minAddOns AND CHARINDEX(@space,p.SKU)=@none ORDER BY p.SKU
